relationships.subject: ACC SST interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: optogenetic silencing of SST neurons enhancing vicarious freezing and activation of SST neurons reducing this behavior

relationships.subject: ACC-PAG projection neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: distinct populations of ACC neurons projecting to the periaqueductal gray (PAG), but not to the basolateral amygdala (BLA), selectively convey affective pain information and regulate observational fear

key_findings: ACC pyramidal neuron population dynamics encoding vicarious freezing are conserved with affective, not sensory, direct pain responses.
ACC-PAG, but not ACC-BLA, neurons convey affective pain information and regulate observational fear.
